payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel RGB, 28×28 standard MedMNIST distribution) loaded with split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) matching official sizes exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA256 are present and the verified MD5 matches the manifest. All selected index SHA256 hashes are recorded per split. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is properly documented and is a known characteristic of PathMNIST, not a defect. Run manifest is internally consistent: seed 47, deterministic_torch=true, lightning_cli=true, package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, medmnist 3.0.2, numpy 2.4.6) are plausible for the 2026-10-02 timestamp. No deterministic findings were raised. The null llm_model_digest is a minor provenance gap (the Ollama model 'qwen3.8' has no content hash recorded) but does not affect the ingestion of the dataset or the deterministic pipeline; it is noted as a traceability observation only. No omitted artifacts. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for 'qwen3.8' via Ollama; consider recording a model snapshot hash or version pin for full reproducibility traceability (non-blocking).
